summary: Bryan Skilinski, 40, of New York — wandered five nights in a winter storm in Great Sand Dunes NP with no survival gear; found ~1 mi south of the visitor center in relatively good health by park rangers, dog teams and search aircraft (separate incident from his May-2017 fatality, id 2579)
location: Great Sand Dunes National Park, near the visitor center
responding_agency: NPS rangers, dog teams, search aircraft
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE — contemporary press gives only 'February 2017'; Feb 11 from a later recounting. Incident-focused only. | run 804: AVSAR missions-from-2017 page documents the 2/15-2/16 multi-agency search (standby, hasty search, SAR dog, found 2/16); parent-opened
